diagnosis.primary: 0..1 active rank=1 per encounter; exactly one on clinical finalize; secondary ranks>=2 unique
diagnosis.freeTextRule: Exactly one of code or nonCodedText; keep text, no invented ICD code; final clinical diagnosis is clinician decision; coded claims need correct catalogue
diagnosis.history: Diagnosis belongs to patient+visit+encounter; no automatic carry to subsequent encounters. Update creates audited revision; void needs reason and retains prior version

allergy.nonCodedRule: Code absent requires original allergen text and category; OTHER requires text; reactions OTHER require text

screening.not_asked: No statement about allergy list; retain all prior allergies
screening.unknown: Keep previous allergy list and unknown screening
screening.no_known_allergy: Encounter-scoped screening assertion only; never delete/resolve/void prior list automatically; flag conflict if active allergies exist
screening.present: Detailed allergy entries or linked existing entries with confirmation; do not create empty placeholder

allergy.enteredInError: Native void plus reason; FHIR.verificationStatus=entered-in-error, omit clinicalStatus
allergy.resolved: Adapter lifecycle state, not native void; no automatic resolution from a new screening
allergy.severity: Event severity mild/moderate/severe or null plus unknown reason; criticality estimates future risk separately
allergy.nativeLimits: Core Allergy has patient/allergen/severity/reactions/comments/encounter; lifecycle, category-other and missing states require adapter persistence

prescription.rounding: Decimal arithmetic, never binary floats. Keep exact dose; explicit quantity rounded UP to quantityStep with reason/confirmation, never silently change dose. No automatic dose from amount dispensed
prescription.fractionalDose: Only synthetic splitAllowed tablet can use fractions of tablets in tests; sample products cannot be assumed splittable. No mass/volume conversion without verified concentration
prescription.quantity: Explicit positive quantity with matching unit. Fixed-frequency test calculation may compare dose*frequency*days in identical units; PRN requires explicit quantity and max/day, never invent frequency
prescription.revision: Confirmed prescription immutable snapshot; corrections create new prescription/DrugOrder REVISE with previousOrder; discontinue obsolete active order, no in-place overwrite
prescription.cancel: Unconfirmed draft cancellation stays adapter-only. Confirmed active order requires explicit discontinue/action=DISCONTINUE plus reason; void only entered-in-error, not ordinary cancellation
prescription.dispense: Confirmed immutable snapshot only, reject cancelled visit or discontinued order; partial allowed up to remaining total, exact Decimal step; idempotency key scoped facility+prescription+line and payload hash; same key/different payload=409; row lock/unique DB constraint

native.draft: adapter only; do not activate native DrugOrder
native.confirmed: DrugOrder action NEW/REVISE; dateActivated; patient/encounter/orderer/careSetting required

billing.discount: Explicit integer VND per line; 0..line gross. No percentage taxes/BHYT inference; snapshot gross-discount=net
billing.rounding: VND has no fractional amount in this application. Quantity integer for service bills; medication fractional dispensing has separate priced line calculation requiring explicit approved rounding
billing.cancel: Unpaid bill can cancel with reason; paid bill needs explicit linked refund, never delete payment
billing.refund: Positive refund amount, linked successful receipt, <=remaining refundable amount; no automatic refund on visit/order cancel
billing.paymentConfirmation: bank_transfer stays pending until settlement confirmed; exclude pending from revenue
billing.prepay: Service execution needs paid matching bill before start; clinical registration/vitals can proceed; no bypass inferred from FE flag
billing.postpay: Service can execute before collection; outstanding bill survives visit close

checks: Size of actual stream, reject empty/over limit
MIME sniff and allowlist, reject HTML/SVG/executables
patient/order/result linkage and RBAC for read/print/download
Private object storage, opaque key, hash, quarantine/scanning, no trust in filename or user Content-Type

orderResult.correction: New revision with reason, previous result reference, author/reviewer/time; retain previous final, lock optimistic revision; no in-place overwrite
orderResult.native: Assignment/in_progress/completed are execution extension states; OpenMRS Order activation/discontinuation/void alone does not mean result complete
